questions.question: R jogs at twice the speed of walking and runs at twice the speed of jogging. From his home to office, he covers half of the distance by walking and the rest by jogging. What is his average speed (in km/h) in a complete round from his home to office and back home if the distance between his office and home is 10 km and he walks at the speed of 7 km/h? questions.solution:
Let the fourth co-ordinate be S(x,y)
Mid point of diagonals of rectangle will be
1) (x + 12)/2 = (6 + 12)/2 ; x = 6
2) (y + 3)/2 = (3 +9)/2; y = 9
